verdict.summary: All 12 typed SourceEvidence fixtures were exact. All 12 fallback fixtures were non-exact: nine contract-complete structural families were underrecognized, and three correctly indeterminate fixtures exposed semantic-hint authority leakage plus isolated high-indeterminate routing. All 148 field deltas are engine defects; no oracle defect or genuine ambiguity was found.

typedEvidence.finding: Typed evidence remained authoritative over contradictory prose, metadata, semantic hints, and opaque capability identity. Complete typed variants without toolFamily were source-owned, while typed authorization without toolFamily was tool-owned.

structuralFallback.finding: The nine complete fallback families were phrased independently but supplied every contract fact. The other three intentionally supplied only quoted, hypothetical, negated, or opaque evidence and were correctly expected to remain indeterminate.

rootCauses.finding: The fallback compiler recognizes narrow sentence templates rather than the contract's wording-independent event families; it also reads summary without composing title facts.

Non-relation semanticHints leak into ontology authority, semantic agreement, or isolated routing. Under the frozen output contract, only relation hints may affect continuity and no semantic hint may change Observation or judgment fields.
When structural compilation fails, the legacy path uses toolFamily to produce subject tool. Capability identity may establish ownership and be copied, but may not determine subject or behavior.

Complete no-toolFamily families fell into engine-owned indeterminacy instead of source ownership; authorization should remain tool-owned without a capability identity. Typed fixtures prove the ownership rules themselves are implementable.

The complete runtime contradiction was suppressed by routine success text, explicitly absent evidence became a runtime diagnostic, and a complete document boundary was not recognized. The two incomplete quoted or hypothetical negative cases did remain indeterminate.
The consolidated event-fact grammar has no expected-diagnostic family for a complete bounded source diagnostic result.
An already-correct high-consequence indeterminate Observation was queued because low-confidence abstained hints won generic uncertainty routing; the isolated profile requires activate/now.

correctionPolicy: Leave typed SourceEvidence validation, lowering, normalization, judgment, and planning unchanged.

Compile wording-independent event facts from title and summary into the existing TaskFailureObservationSyntax; do not depend on metadata, semanticHints, capability names, or holdout sentence templates.
Keep non-relation semanticHints from changing Observation enrichment, provenance authority, semantic agreement, judgment, or isolated decision routing; relation hints may affect continuity only.
Represent expected diagnostics as a first-class structural fallback family and preserve distinct none, absent, partial, and unknown evidence loss.

Apply terminal precedence after clause scoping: asserted complete diagnostics outrank success, payload, and control, while quoted, hypothetical, conditional, negated, documentation, and reference clauses cannot create terminal evidence.

Derive subject from the structural family. Use toolFamily only for ownership and exact identity copying; classified no-toolFamily evidence is source-owned, authorization is tool-owned, and only indeterminate no-toolFamily evidence is engine-owned.
Route the isolated high-consequence indeterminate Observation to activate/now before generic low-confidence or abstention peripheralization.
Do not edit or relabel the V5 oracle or first-run artifact. Retire V5 after implementation changes and require a fresh independently authored holdout for the next release freeze.
